0022600223.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-8, 13th in the East, 1-5 on the road) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (4-6, 11th in the West, 3-3 at home) for the 11th game of Brooklyn's season, with both teams on two-game losing streaks. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (out, leg bruise) and Mikel Brown Jr. (day-to-day, game-time decision, rest), while New Orleans is missing Trendon Watford (ankle), Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis), Yves Missi (knee bruise) and Zion Williamson (rest). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet in 2026-27, and their last meeting was on January 14, 2026, in New Orleans, when the Nets lost 116-113.
